senses.gloss: f. (sing. a. pl.) (carrucha, carruca) travelling and state carriage. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 18">B’shall. 18</cite> <he>מעשה … ועברה קרובים וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) it happened to King Shabur when he passed there (in the desert of Kub), that one of his carriages passed and a serpent swallowed it, a second &c.; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 255">Yalk. Ex. 255</cite> <cite ref="U00912"><he>שיירה</he></cite>); Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ <he>חיויא</he> … <he>בלע כרוכין</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קרונין</he>, corr. acc.) the serpent, in the case of King Shabur, swallowed camels, swallowed carriages; Y. Ned. III, 37ᵈ <cite ref="S00100"><he>קברין</he></cite> (corr. acc.). Y. Shebu. l. c. <he>אנא חמית משך … ק׳ דמלכותא</he> I saw the skin of a serpent that went on (was used as a cover for) the royal carriage; Y. Ned. l. c. <he>בדיויין למלכותא</he> (corr. acc.). Y. Meg. I, 70ᶜ bot. <he>עד שהגיע לק׳ שלו</he> until he reached his (Nicanor’s) carriage; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:12:3">Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ</cite> top <he>לקרובין</he> (corr. acc.); Meg. Taan. ch. XII.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:10">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>למלך</he> … <he>שהיו בק׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בקרונין</he>, corr. acc.) the king and the viceroy were in a carriage; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:10">Koh. R. to VI, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 261">Yalk. Is. 261</cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>ומלאו כל הכ׳ דם</he> Ar. (ed., v. <cite ref="S01951"><he>קָרוֹן</he></cite>) all the carriages were filled with blood; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1033">Yalk. Lam. 1033</cite>, sq. <he>קרוקין</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, end <he>בכורכין</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="J00580"><he>יָקר</he></cite>; a. fr. (corrupt <he>קרובין</he>, <he>קרונין</he>).
